{{Top|leg}}
The '''High Council building''' was a building where the [[High Council of Alderaan]] met for an unknown time until at least [[3653 BBY]] where it housed the [[Alderaan peace conference|Alderaan Peace Conference]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], and here after the news of the surprise [[Sacking of Coruscant]], was signed the humiliant [[Treaty of Coruscant]].
